title: File:DGJ 3864 - Buy, Buy, Buy...... (3708439994).jpg
author: Dennis G. Jarvis
description:
Walking back to the hotel we went along the Night Bazaar area on Chang Klan Road. Various shops and products from many places in Thailand. The Night Bazaar area has a variety of magnificent cultural shows every night.
Neat we head for Wat Phra Singh is perhaps the largest and most interesting temple in Chiang Mai.
